scenario: A registration number is rejected, then one corrected attempt is made.

application_events: Student had already used the agreement control.
turns.student_message: My registration number is 23/A/93939. Wi-Fi will not connect. Please create a support draft in category it_webmail_wifi.
turns.reply:
I do not have confirmed information about Wi-Fi connection troubleshooting in the approved university documents.

Regarding your support draft, I was unable to create it because 23/A/93939 is not a valid registration number format. Registration numbers must start with two digits, followed by U or X, four or five digits, and optionally /PS or /EVE (such as 23/U/93939). Please provide a valid registration number so I can assist you with creating the support draft.

validation_errors.message: Use two digits, U or X, four or five digits, and optionally /PS or /EVE.

turns.student_message: The correct registration number is 23/U/22615. Please create the support draft with that number.
turns.reply:
Your support draft has been successfully created with case ID CASE-2026-000001 for registration number 23/U/22615 under the IT, Webmail, and Wi-Fi category. 

Please note that saving this draft does not automatically contact an office or submit an official request, and the draft cannot be closed or canceled through this chat.
